facts.sentence: On Friday, Nov 13, 1,615 of the 1,842 elevators AGSIST reads with the same delivery month both days posted a lower cash corn bid than Thursday, 194 a higher one; 158 changed their basis, 6 weaker and 152 stronger.
facts.detail: 33 unchanged; median change 1¢ lower. Biggest state move: Ohio, 1¼¢ lower (76 elevators).
facts.unit: cents per bushel, median change in cash bid
facts.comparison: last posted bid on 2026-11-13 vs 2026-11-12, same board, crop and delivery period
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, last posted bid per trading day (data/bids-prev)
